display.purpose: The player's name in the signing hero. STAR Display = Anton (Latin, digits) + Karantina Bold (Hebrew) under one family via unicode-range.

score.purpose: Match scores; the OVR block numeral (2.6rem) and the verdict band (2.4rem) sit between Score and Headline.

headline.purpose: An offer or trial club's name in its announcement head.

title.purpose: Section titles, the top-bar title, home ledger labels.

button.purpose: Primary and club buttons, condensed caps.

figure.purpose: Attribute values, season stats, prices on price buttons.

caption.purpose: Tab labels, the OVR caption, gear-slot status; the 11px floor.

shadows.name: toast
shadows.purpose: The reward toast that floats above content; the only drop shadow.

shadows.name: dot-ring
shadows.purpose: Separates the gold store dot from the nav icon under it.

shadows.name: swatch-selected
shadows.purpose: Marks the selected colour swatch in the look sheet.

motion.name: press
motion.purpose: Button background and border transitions; primary and club buttons scale to 0.985 on press (off under reduced motion).

motion.name: ease-out-expo
motion.purpose: Entrances: a new match event (320ms, 6px drop) and the reward toast (420ms, 14px rise).

motion.name: live-pulse
motion.purpose: The red live dot during a running match only.

breakpoints.name: column
breakpoints.purpose: The single screen column and the bottom nav width.

breakpoints.name: nav-sides
breakpoints.purpose: Above this the bottom nav gains hairline sides.

breakpoints.name: compact-skip
breakpoints.purpose: At or below, the hub's skip button shows its icon only (label stays for screen readers).

narrative.overview:
Every screen is an official club announcement about you. Clubs post a graphic when they sign a player: a full-bleed field in the club colour, cut on a diagonal, the player large, the name in ultra-condensed capitals, the shirt number huge behind him. STAR wears that graphic as its interface. Your current club's colours paint the hero of home and the hub, the league table row, a goal in the match feed and the key moment. A transfer repaints the whole game in the new club's colours, so the reward of moving up is visible everywhere. Other clubs appear in their own colours too: an offer arrives as that club's announcement, and you sign in its colours.

Around those fields sits kit black: a neutral near-black (never blue-black) with hairline panels one step up, small square corners and no glow. It reads like a club's matchday graphics or a broadcast lower third, not a toy, which is the point for a 14+ audience. The system was chosen to replace a neon-on-navy look with glossy pill buttons that read as made for young children. Hebrew and English are equal first languages: the display face is two scripts under one family name, and every composition mirrors cleanly in RTL.

Density follows the screen's job. The hero bands are pure announcement (Experience); tables, the store and gear are compact Operate surfaces with hairline rows and tabular numerals. Each screen ends in one clear next action, in white.
keyCharacteristics: The player's club colour is the only large field of colour on a screen; everything else is kit black.
Hero bands are cut at 8° (tan 8° × the band's own width), with the club's second colour as a 6px stripe along the cut.
Display text is ultra-condensed caps (Anton for Latin and digits, Karantina for Hebrew); sentences are Rubik.
One solid white action per view. Gold means coins and rewards, never decoration.
Flat: 4px corners, hairlines, one surface step for depth. No glows, no gradients, no pills.

rules.name: The Club Field Rule
rules.body: The player's club colour is the only large field of colour on a screen. Another club appears in its own colours only inside its own announcement (an offer, a trial, the far half of a score box).

rules.name: The Gold Is Money Rule
rules.body: Gold marks coins and rewarded clips. Stars, ratings, trophies on display and decoration never use coin gold.

rules.name: The Lift, Don't Wash Rule
rules.body: Club colour used as text is lifted in OKLCH at the same hue; mixing it with white turns dark reds salmon and is not allowed.

rules.name: The Two-Script Display Rule
rules.body: Display text is always STAR Display. Never set display text in a face that has no Hebrew, and never letter-space Hebrew.

rules.name: The Caps for Names Rule
rules.body: Condensed caps carry names, numbers, scores and actions. Anything read as a sentence is Rubik in sentence case.

rules.name: The Flat Kit Rule
rules.body: No glows, no coloured halos, no gradients on surfaces. If something needs emphasis, it takes the club field, the white action or gold, not light effects.

rules.name: The 8° Rule
rules.body: Every announcement edge is cut at 8°, measured from its own width, and mirrors with the reading direction. A fixed pixel drop is not allowed: it flattens on wide bands.

rules.name: The No-Pill Rule
rules.body: Buttons, chips and cards are square-cornered. A pill-shaped control does not belong to this world.

dos: Do paint large fields only in the player's club colour (`--club`), with `--club-ink` on top and `--club-2` as the 6px stripe.
Do cut announcement edges at tan 8° × their own width (`--cut: 14.054cqw` inside an inline-size container), falling toward the end side.
Do give each view exactly one paper-white action; make every other action ghost, price, club or rewarded.
Do place a rewarded clip after the action it relates to, with at most one solid gold per view; any further clip is the quiet gold outline.
Do price everything bought with coins on the price button, with the CSS coin mark and display numerals.
Do isolate Latin names inside Hebrew lines with `<bdi>`, and join hyphenated club names (hyphen + U+2060) so they wrap between words.
Do keep the owner's assets as they are: the layered character art, gear images on the light gear plate, procedural club crests and the five-tab bottom nav.
donts: Don't put a kicker or eyebrow label above a heading. Fold it into the heading or a trailing status.
Don't use coin gold for stars, ratings, tiers on display or decoration.
Don't use pill-shaped buttons, glows, coloured halos, glossy fills or surface gradients.
Don't use blue-black grounds; the ground is the neutral `kit-black` (#0e0e10).
Don't set display text in a face without Hebrew glyphs, or letter-space Hebrew.
Don't go below 11px for functional text, or use `dim` for text at that size.
Don't let the bottom nav or any bar span wider than the 32rem column.
